messages:
maggie: FYI — after the RBAC cleanup this morning, our SCIM sync from Okta started dropping members from the 'gov-admins' group. Not every member, seems to hit users with longer attributes (emails, display names).

sam: logs?

maggie: pasted relevant log output: 
```
2025-06-01T09:12:34Z ERROR scim/provisioner: PATCH /Groups/0xA... returned 400 - attribute 'members' truncated
assertion_size=12345 bytes, payload_hash=sha256:ab12...
```

jordan: Could be SAML assertion size / attribute truncation when we map groups into the SAML token. Did anyone touch the group expansion code or the Okta mapping? Any KMS errors for signing?

maggie: idp-bot reported SAML probe failures exactly around 09:12:33: "AssertionTooLarge". Platform logs show successful KMS decrypts for the signing key — no decrypt failures.

izaac: I also noticed audit entries for role assignment without full context (missing group attributes). That would explain orphaned roles in RBAC (users appear removed).

sam: Short-term workaround: switch mapping to send group IDs (shorter) instead of full group names. Long-term: either compress claims or push group membership via SCIM sync instead of SAML claims.

maggie: Attempting the group-ID switch in staging now. Patch command: 
```
scim-patch --env=staging --file=patch-groups.json
```

jordan: Also create a vuln-triage ticket to assess whether truncated assertions could be exploited to escalate/lose privileges — truncation might lead to incorrect RBAC decisions.

maggie: Created SEC-2025-143 and assigned @sam for audit log triage and @izaac to coordinate mapping changes with Okta.

idp-bot: probe: SAML assertion size=12512 bytes > configured_max=12288 — rejected by IdP.

sam: Confirmed. Looks like Okta enforces ~12KB attribute payload. We either need to shrink the SAML payload or move group data into SCIM.

izaac: KMS side: decrypts look fine, but double-check envelope headers (JWE alg) — our rotated signer might have switched alg or header fields that cause intermediate proxies to alter size/encoding. Also verify the cert chain used for SAML signing is the one we intended.

maggie: Note — we rotated the SAML cert last night at ~02:00. I rolled back to previous cert and retriggered a staging SCIM resync: staging resync completed successfully and group members restored.

sam: Good validation. Runbook we followed (short):
```
1) pause scim sync: POST /api/admin/scim/pause
2) roll cert: POST /api/admin/saml/rotate-cert?action=rollback&from=prev
3) trigger scim resync: POST /api/admin/scim/resync?group=gov-admins
4) verify audit: GET /api/admin/audit?entity=group&from=09:00
```

jordan: Agreed next steps: 1) change Okta mapping to externalId/group-id to avoid long strings, 2) add fallback SCIM-only sync for groups above threshold, 3) update incident runbook with cert rotation checklist and KMS header verification, 4) postmortem + scheduled coordinated cert rotation with Okta.

maggie: I'll draft the postmortem and link it to SEC-2025-143: https://docs.internal/reports/SEC-2025-143 — adding timeline and mitigation steps.

sam: :thumbsup:

maggie: Thanks y'all, I'll close this thread after postmortem reviewed.
